feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 17 May 2026 11:39am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 17 May 2026 at 11:40am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the northwest of Scotland as various troughs approach from the west of Ireland.


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, decreasing 2 to 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate this afternoon & evening.


##Weather##

Scattered showers spreading from the west this afternoon, becoming more widespread later this evening & tonight. Then soon mainly fair tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 2 to 4, backing southeast 4 or 5 during the evening, increasing 5 or 6 occasionally 7 overnight. Veering on Tuesday morning to south or southwest 4 or 5 occasional 6.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming mainly moderate.


##Weather##

Fair at first, rain spreading from the southwest in the evening & night, clearing to showers on Tuesday morning.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor at times in the rain.
